messages:
Alex: Hey team — customer (FinAtlas) asked for SOC 2 report, ISO cert, and a signed pen-test letter before POC kickoff. They also want a committed POC price for 30 days. Ping legal? :eyes:
Jordan: Thanks Alex. Can you drop their tightest deadline? We should collect artifacts in a zip to share with them. I'll prep a staging environment quote. :thumbsup:
Alex: Need it by EOD Friday. They said "no-go" without pen-test letter signed by vendor.
Maya: FYI our standard is an attestation + pen-test attestation letter (not full signed PT report). Fully-signed vendor pen-test letters require legal review and external pen-test coordination — takes 7-10 business days. We can offer an interim attestation to unblock POC.
Sam: For POC we can spin a Dedicated trial with VPC peering and limited ingress — that adds ~$3k for reserved capacity. If they need staging creds, we prefer time-limited service tokens and a jumpbox. Security constraints: no production data, encryption enforced.
Jordan: I'll draft a pricing line: POC baseline (30d hosted) = $X, Dedicated VPC add-on = $3k. Need final sign-off from finance on discounts.
Alex: Can security produce the SOC2/ISO PDFs and a short attestation now? Customer is fine with redacted reports if needed.
Maya: Yes — we can provide SOC 2 Type II summary PDF (redacted) + ISO 27001 cert. For pen-test: offer "Pen-test attestation letter" stating we engage annual PT provider and will provide remediation timeline. If legal okays, we can add signature. Sample text below:
Maya: ```
Redwood Inference attests that internal penetration testing is conducted annually by a third-party provider. A summary of findings and remediation status may be shared under NDA upon request.
``` 
Maya: I'll loop in legal. cc @LegalTeam
Audit Bot: Artifact bundle available: https://s3.company.com/redwood/finatlas-poc-evidence-1748625000.zip (expires in 7 days)
Jordan: Uploaded pricing + SOW stub to that folder and marked redactions. Shared with customer via secure link.
Alex: Perfect. Action items: Maya -> legal for pen-test signature; Jordan -> final SOW & price; Sam -> provisioning estimate. Back to you all tomorrow. :lock:
